creation.freshness: Before claim or up: label and name inventories for containers including stopped containers, all eight declared project volume names, and both exact project networks must be absent.
creation.claim: Exclusive private file mode0600 in private directory0700, scoped to project/run/attempt, Docker engine hash, resolved configuration hash, all absent names and the exact eligible service/volume closure. No credentials or raw engine identity.
creation.persistence: Claim survives for the separate workflow cleanup invocation; an existing claim is never overwritten.
creation.eligible_closure: Only default services plus the explicit credentials helper, their seven named volumes, and the two project networks. Inactive operator services and operator_output are not creation/deletion authority.

cleanup.claim_guard: Missing claim performs no sweep. Foreign, malformed, symlink, shared-permission, wrong-owner or oversized claims fail before resource mutation.
cleanup.resource_guard: Name and label inventories, exact volume role/driver/options, container role/name/mounts, network name/label/driver/internal state and attached-container closure are verified before any deletion.
cleanup.targets: Stop owned full container IDs with35-second grace, remove those exact IDs, remove verified full network IDs, then remove only verified named volumes. No compose down, --volumes, --remove-orphans or force deletion.
cleanup.partial_and_missing: Partial startup and cancelled owned helper containers remain cleanable. Already-missing resources are skipped; retained valid claim permits idempotent later cleanup.
cleanup.bounds: Read/ownership validation deadline55 seconds; deletion phase deadline120 seconds. Cleanup is separate from qualification time and does not grant additional suite time.
